expect_red: a hover posts highlight on its edge and clear off it, at most a few messages a second

mutations.contract: The hover debounce bounds how many messages a second the iframe receives.
mutations.note: A zero debounce posts on every mouseover -- dozens a second while a pointer crosses a table -- and every one of them repaints a colour buffer in the annotator.

mutations.contract: Leaving an edge posts `highlight clear`, never a highlight of nothing.
mutations.note: Without the clear arm, resting off any row would post `highlight <topology> undefined`, which the annotator refuses, and the last tint would never come down.
